live_acceptance.evidence: The old 25/25 LRC proof established only that yonige's recording was audible. User correction plus the static goodbye-card timeline established background playback, not Li Dousha singing. In the fresh current joint-gate run, automatic LRCLIB discovery and 25/25 timing succeeded; AGY v4 overcalled the playback as live, but host-vocal-proof.v2 scored 0/7 and the final AND returned SONG_NOT_LIDOUSHA_SINGING. A confirmed live Li Dousha v5 run passed 6/7 against both pinned enrollments and its same-session host anchor. A loud Li-Dousha-speech-over-BGM adversarial mix can make CAM++ alone pass, while same-audio static replay requires AGY's non-live veto, so neither layer is sufficient alone.
